title: Estimating the reproducibility of psychological science
research_question: Do public metadata services agree on the identification of this published study, with source-specific retrieval witnesses?
measurement: Normalized DOI, article title and publication year compared independently across Crossref and OpenAlex
counterexample: Different DOI or materially different title/year, missing source, or source version ambiguity
scope: Bibliographic identity only. No study statistics, hypotheses or replication results are independently recomputed.
data_privacy: Public bibliographic metadata only; no participant-level data
access_review: Only named public metadata API records; do not fetch articles or supplemental datasets.
